item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:

item.title: A message from Guidance:
item.description: Queens and Algonquin are here this week! Sign up in the Guidance office before the presentation - deadline to sign up for Algonquin College is the end of the day today.

item.title: A message from Mr. Lannin and Mr. Benoit
item.description: Congratulations to the Boys and Girls Grade 7/8 soccer teams for their strong showing at the St. Mike's tournament yesterday. The boys won all 4 of their games while the Girls had a strong day with 2 wis and a tie. Well done to all players.

item.title: A Message From: Mme Perron.
item.description: There will be a very important Europe team meeting today at the beginning of lunch. All travelers must attend as we have important information to share about Trivia Night on Saturday! All staff and students are welcome to attend Trivia Night being held at the Russell Arena on Saturday evening. Please see Mme Perron or Mme. Bourdon today for ticket information. Lots of items up for auction!!
